# Security Policy for InputFlow

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 1.0.x   | Yes       |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in InputFlow, please report it responsibly:

1. Open a [Security Advisory](https://github.com/{user}/inputflow/security/advisories/new) via GitHub.
2. Do NOT open a public issue for security-sensitive findings.
3. We aim to respond within 48 hours and publish a fix within 7 days for critical issues.

## Privacy Assurance

InputFlow is designed with privacy as a core principle:
- No network communication under normal operation
- All data stored locally with SQLCipher encryption
- No analytics, crash reporting, or third-party SDKs
- Runs at standard user privileges

See [PRIVACY.md](../PRIVACY.md) for full details.
